title: Same Targets, Different Computation: How Post-Training Divides Work Across Model Layers
note: Cross-patching: base upstream hidden state written into the descendant's late stack at every sequence position (keys/values recomputed); boundary sweep 40% depth to final block, random-later-disagreement and history controls. title: Not All Layers Need Tuning: Selective Layer Restoration Recovers Diversity

title: Controlling the Diversity-Quality Trade-Off of LLMs by Merging Models Before and After Alignment
note: Depth-aware FrankenMerging: aligned lower layers + base higher layers; higher semantic diversity than aligned; better trade-off than temperature. Weight/layer splice (reverse composition of B1); text tasks only.

title: Locked at the Entrance, Open Inside: Where RLVR Narrows the Solution Space
note: Locked at the Entrance: RLVR contraction concentrated at the entrance (first operand/operator family) on Countdown; entrance prefix restores low-access families; layer interpolation restores entrance diversity (+37% coverage). Weight-level; arithmetic puzzle, not code. Abstract only (PDF 403).

title: Should SFT Prefer the Familiar? Diversity Collapse and Recovery via Model Merging
note: Merging the SFT model with its pretrained base before RL restores diversity (math and code benchmarks). Whole-model weight merge; no site or random controls.

title: Beyond Learning: A Training-Free Alternative to Model Adaptation
